findings.title: Zero-length overrides are never recognized
findings.body: This compares two Dayjs objects with `===`, which only checks object identity and is always false for these separately created instances. Consequently, a zero-length date override falls through to `dateOverrideExist` and returns `true`, making every generated slot on that override date available instead of applying the intended empty interval.

findings.title: Per-host working-hours check ignores the event end time
findings.body: `end` is computed from the slot start just like `start`, so the `end > workingHour.endTime` condition can never detect a booking that extends past a host's working-hours boundary. In round-robin events this can leave a slot available even when the assigned host cannot accommodate the full event.
